categories.main_business_segments: SF Holding operates primarily in comprehensive logistics services including time-sensitive express delivery, economic express, freight transport, cold chain and pharmaceutical logistics, same-city instant delivery, and supply chain and international logistics. The company provides end-to-end domestic and international logistics solutions, covering air, sea, rail, and road transport, as well as warehousing and last-mile delivery services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital and intelligent technologies such as AI algorithms, large language models, autonomous vehicles, automated sorting centers, and robotic process automation (RPA) to enhance operational efficiency and customer service. It has developed proprietary logistics decision-making models and integrates IoT, cloud computing, and blockchain to build a smart supply chain ecosystem. Automation and unmanned technologies are widely applied in sorting, transportation, and warehousing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SF Holding serves a diverse customer base including e-commerce platforms, manufacturers, trade enterprises, cross-border e-commerce businesses, and individual consumers. Key industries served include high-tech electronics, automotive, pharmaceuticals, fresh produce, consumer goods, and industrial manufacturing. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, especially in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has extensive coverage across China, with 100% coverage of prefecture-level cities and nearly full county-level coverage. Internationally, it operates in over 206 countries and regions, with strong presence in Asia-Pacific countries such as Southeast Asia, Japan, and Korea, as well as expanding networks in Europe and the Americas. It owns and operates major logistics hubs including the Ezhou air freight hub and maintains a large fleet of cargo aircraft.
categories.supply_chain_position: SF Holding operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the logistics supply chain, providing integrated logistics services including transportation, warehousing, distribution, and last-mile delivery. It also offers upstream supply chain solutions such as inventory management and end-to-end supply chain optimization for clients, positioning itself as a comprehensive logistics and supply chain solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation and intelligent logistics innovation, focusing on developing AI-driven decision models, autonomous logistics technologies, and smart supply chain solutions. R&D efforts emphasize automation, unmanned operations, and SaaS-based logistics services for small and medium enterprises. SF Holding aims to deepen industry-specific logistics solutions, expand international networks, and enhance green logistics technologies to support sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: SF Holding generates revenue mainly through logistics and freight forwarding service fees, including express delivery, freight transport, cold chain logistics, same-city delivery, and supply chain management services. Additional revenue streams include warehousing, value-added services, leasing, and technology solutions. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SF Holding is the largest logistics and express delivery provider in China and Asia, and ranks as the fourth largest comprehensive logistics service provider globally. It holds leading market positions in multiple segments such as time-sensitive express, freight transport, cold chain, and same-city delivery. The company competes with other major domestic and international logistics firms but differentiates itself through its integrated service offerings, technology leadership, and extensive network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SF Holding reported total revenue of approximately RMB 284.4 billion, representing a 10.1% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 10.17 billion, up 23.5% from the prior year. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets of RMB 2.138 trillion and continues to invest in network expansion and technology. Its financial metrics show improving profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SF Holding emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and time-sensitive logistics services supported by advanced technology and a comprehensive service portfolio. Its value proposition includes end-to-end integrated logistics solutions tailored to diverse industry needs, superior customer experience, and a strong brand reputation for speed and service excellence. The company also focuses on sustainable logistics practices and digital supply chain innovation to differentiate itself in a competitive market.
